name: Ollama
hook: A compact guide to native compilation, faster Go-only iteration, testing, contribution rules, and fuller setup docs.
summary: Ollama's root file offers two build paths. One builds the native payload with CMake; the quicker one reuses that payload and runs the Go code. Testing, contribution rules, and fuller setup instructions live in the linked development guide.

techniques.title: State the prerequisite for a faster loop
techniques.body: The Go-only commands are explicitly conditional on an existing native payload. That condition stops the shorter command from looking like a replacement for a complete first build.
techniques.quote: For quick Go-only iteration against an existing native payload:

techniques.title: Route setup details to one guide
techniques.body: The root names what the development guide covers, so a reader knows when to leave the short command list for platform and GPU setup.
techniques.quote:
See `docs/development.md` for prerequisites, platform notes, GPU backends, and
the full development workflow.

steal: Label fast commands with the state they assume already exists.
Separate first-build instructions from the everyday edit loop.
Keep platform-specific setup in a linked development guide.
